'''Sean Bass''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[June 2001 Raleigh tournament (first event)]] in June 2001 with YMSYL (5th Marker, IAO, Decree), according to Edwin Harris's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2413">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-05-raleigh-ncd2413/ raleigh-nc], DeckTech (Edwin "Edwin" Harris, 5 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-05-raleigh-ncd2413/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
